messages:
From: Aamir Khan <aamir@seaforth.ai>

Cc: billing@seaforth.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interim add-on + mid-cycle seats (urgent)

Hi Lauren,

Quick background: we added 12 extra concurrent seats on Oct 1 to cover a short-term burst for a partner pilot. Our finance team reports a merchant hold on the charge for the provisional invoice (PID 2026-1001) because the VAT ID on the PO is incomplete — they flagged EU reverse-charge questions. They need an amended invoice showing a pro-rated amount for Oct 1–Oct 31 so our AP can clear the payment.

Invoice attached: seaforth_interim_invoice_20261001.pdf (provisional) — merchant decline code: 402-MERCH-HOLD.

Request: can Redwood reissue an interim invoice that splits the Oct add-on so standard seat subscription (10 seats) is billed as normal and the 12-seat burst is billed pro-rata for Oct 1–31 with VAT line clarified (we're an EU-registered entity; VAT number ends with GB123). If reverse-charge applies please show the VAT ID and a 0% VAT line with the reverse-charge note. Our AP prefers a separate credit/proforma for the original provisional charge so they can reconcile.

Can you confirm ETA and whether you need anything else (signed PO, VAT cert)? We're blocking on this for payment; if we can't clear the charge by Oct 14 the pilot gets delayed.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Aamir
Aamir Khan
Head of Ops, Seaforth AI
A: 88 Mariner St, London
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Aamir Khan <aamir@seaforth.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interim add-on + mid-cycle seats (urgent)

Hi Aamir — thanks for the details and the provisional invoice.

Short answer: yes, we can reissue an amended interim invoice that separates the base subscription and the Oct add-on, shows a pro-rated charge for the 12-seat burst (Oct 1–31), and includes an explicit VAT reverse-charge line if you confirm the VAT ID and entitled business status.

What I'll do now:
- Loop in billing ops (cc'd) to prepare a credit note for the provisional invoice and an amended invoice showing the split.
- Propose the pro-rata math we use so you can confirm: (monthly_unit_price * seats * days_active / days_in_billing_month). For clarity, we'll show the calculation on the invoice explanatory note.
- If Seaforth confirms VAT GB123 and that the service is B2B, we'll add the reverse-charge text and 0% VAT line.

Aditya / Rishi — can you prioritize creating: 1) credit note (to cancel provisional PID 2026-1001), 2) amended interim invoice showing two lines (base subscription for 10 seats full month + add-on 12 seats pro-rated for 31 days), and 3) a proforma PDF for Seaforth to attach to their PO? Aim for EOD Oct 12 PST. Also please confirm whether the system will treat the add-on as an "ephemeral burst" SKU (so that usage-backed billing doesn't change the subscription seat count).

Aamir — if you can reply with the exact VAT ID and a short note from AP confirming they need the separate credit/proforma that will speed things up.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Account Director, Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Seaforth — pro-rate calc + tax note (please draft)

Aditya / Rishi — internal quick:

Examples/numbers (please use exact pricing from the account):
- Seat list price (monthly): $200 per seat
- Base seats: 10 seats (billed full month)
- Burst seats: 12 seats (Oct 1–31, pro-rated for 31 days)

Pro-rata line calculation for burst: 200 * 12 * (31/31) = $2,400 (since they started Oct 1 — full-month pro-rata, but we still treat as add-on line). If they had started mid-month we'd compute days_active/days_in_month.

However, finance flagged they would like the burst on a separate line so Seaforth's AP can route the payment separately (merchant reconciliation). That means we need:
- Credit note reversing the original provisional charge (PID 2026-1001)
- Amended invoice A: subscription base (10 seats) — invoice PID 2026-1002
- Amended invoice B: burst/add-on (12 seats) — invoice PID 2026-1003 (pro-rata)

Tax handling: Seaforth indicates EU B2B with GB VAT. If reverse-charge applies (confirm with their AP), we should show: VAT 0% with note "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the customer per EU VAT directives." Include customer VAT ID on the invoice. Otherwise include standard US sales tax (if applicable) or leave tax blank and attach tax guidance doc.

Can you draft the two PDFs and the credit note and attach the calculation stub for transparency? Also include the merchant decline code and the required invoice fields Seaforth's bank needs to clear (VAT ID, PO ref, separate credit/proforma). Send drafts to me for sign-off before reissue.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Lauren
